~ 效率节点和可切换的高档工作流程 ~

我做这个是因为我厌倦了我的驱动器被糟糕的一族堵塞。找不到任何可以按照我想要的方式工作的东西，所以我自己构建了它。

它的作用

首先在预览模式下生成图像。除非你告诉它，否则什么都不会被保存。如果图像很糟糕，只需再次生成即可。如果效果好，请切换一些开关并再次运行它以升级并保存。

如何使用

  1. 点击生成，查看预览

  2. 如果是垃圾，则重新生成

  3. 如果还不错：在效率采样器中打开“reuse_seed”，打开“Fast Bypass”，然后再次生成

  4. 出现相同的图像，但这次它被放大并保存

还有一个“省钱又不高档如果您只想保存原始文件，请切换。

里面有什么

  • 默认预览模式

  • 使用快速组旁路器进行升级

  • 分辨率列表（有一个注释解释了要使用哪些分辨率）

  • LoRA堆叠器

  • 专为效率节点而打造

你需要的东西

  • 效率节点

  • 红三

  • SDXL 模型（不适用于 Flux 或其他东西）

两者都从 舒适UI管理器.

整个重用种子+旁路切换的事情有点笨重，但它有效。使用它已经有一段时间了，我的文件夹不再充满垃圾了。

~ EfficiencyNodes and Togglelable Upscale Workflow ~

I made this because I was tired of my drive getting clogged with shitty gens. Couldn't find anything that worked the way I wanted so I just built it myself.

What it does

Generates images in preview mode first. Nothing gets saved until you tell it to. If the image sucks, just gen again. If it's good, toggle some switches and run it again to get it upscaled and saved.

How to use

  1. Hit generate, look at preview

  2. If it's trash, generate again

  3. If it's decent: turn on "reuse_seed" in the efficiency sampler, turn on "Fast Bypass", then generate once more

  4. Same image comes out but this time it gets upscaled and saved

There's also a "Save without upscale" toggle if you just want to save the original.

What's in it

  • Preview mode by default

  • Upscaling with fast group bypasser

  • Resolution list (there's a note explaining which ones to use)

  • LoRA stacker

  • Built for efficiency nodes

Stuff you need

  • Efficiency nodes

  • rgthree

  • SDXL models (won't work with Flux or other stuff)

Get both from ComfyUI Manager.

The whole reuse seed + bypass toggle thing is kinda clunky but it works. Been using it for a while now and my folders aren't full of garbage anymore.
